## Purpose

Subscriptions decides which meals each household receives each week and keeps the standing order alive: it opens, pauses and cancels subscriptions and locks a week's choice before the cutoff, so that households keep choosing (G1). It does not charge the card (billing) or pack the box (fulfilment).

## Strategic classification

| Domain | Business model | Evolution |
|---|---|---|
| core | revenue-generator | custom |

_Strategize rationale_: G1 (grow active subscribers) is won or lost on how easily a household chooses and changes its weekly meals; no off-the-shelf subscription product models cut-offs, swaps and pauses the way we need, so this is the decisive core and gets a rich domain model. — _future_: Stays core for the foreseeable future; menu-choice UX is the differentiator (bet B1)

## Domain roles

**execution-context** — Execution context: it owns the subscription aggregate and takes the household's commands directly; the weekly cutoff is enforced here, not downstream.

## Business decisions

1. A week can be chosen once; a second choice for the same week is rejected
2. Choices lock at the weekly cutoff; after it, default meals are assigned
